correctness.rationale: For n≥5, non-cycle pairs in complement C_n have distance 1 and cycle-neighbor pairs have distance 2. A finite ℓ1 metric decomposes into nonnegative cut semimetrics. The cyclic seven-point cut inequality 3E1≤E2+4E3 gives 42≤35c; a second seven-linear-point cut inequality whose right coefficients sum to 10 gives 12≤10c on every seven consecutive labels for n≥8. Each cut inequality was independently verified for all 2^7 masks, establishing a finite lemma rather than an experiment extrapolation. Independent rational averaged-cut recomputation produces exact d_n for n=5,6 and distortion 6/5 at n=7. Therefore c1=1 for 5,6, exactly 6/5 for 7, and ≥6/5 for n≥8, without claiming exact values at higher n.
